newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Yen-based aluminium futures finished mixed in thin trade on Wednesday as individual investors continued to focus on volatile precious metals futures, traders said.

"The rise on the LME was offset by the dollar's advance (against the yen)," said a trader at one of Japan's leading trading houses. "I hadn't expected aluminium on the LME to come this far. But in Tokyo, investors are looking at precious metals," he said.
The benchmark June contract shed 0.5 yen to end at 192.3 yen, April was down 0.3 yen at 193.5 yen, while February added 0.5 yen to 194.6 and December rose 0.6 to 194.7 yen.
In London overnight, the benchmark three month aluminium gained $6 to end at $1,615, well above the key $1,600 level.
